description: Import a bank statement (JSON, PDF, DAT, CSV or Excel xlsx; base64, up to 3 MB). Skips exact duplicates (listed in duplicatesSkipped), imports but flags look-alikes with a different description (possibleDuplicates), records the balance the statement reports instead of importing balance lines as transactions, and returns the last bank-synced balance and the unmatched transactions. CSV and Excel statements must match a known bank layout (Hapoalim, Leumi, Discount, Mizrahi-Tefahot or generic headers); unrecognized formats and unknown layouts fail with an explicit "Unsupported statement format" error instead of importing nothing. Bank import tools are available only when a building has bank sync configured.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

fileBase64.description: Base64-encoded bank statement file, up to 3 MB decoded.

filename.description: Original filename; the extension selects the parser (.json, .pdf, .csv, .dat, .xlsx).

mimeType.description: MIME type of the statement file.

name: import_bank_statement
title: Import bank statement
